scripts.start: yarn build:prepare; concurrently "yarn elm-watch hot" "cd dist; python -m http.server 8001"
scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p dist; cp src/index.html src/favicon.svg src/*.js dist; rm -rf dist/img; cp -r img dist/; rm -rf dist/audio; cp -r audio dist/
scripts.build:prepare: yarn; rm -rf dist/*; yarn build:assets; rm -rf generated/*; yarn elm-codegen install; ts-node ./scripts/generate.ts
scripts.build: yarn build:prepare; yarn elm-watch make --optimize; rm game.zip; zip game.zip dist/* -r
